scope: Direct run_cell, TimingDelegate and Budget integration with explicit unittest.mock injection of fabricated source modules, a literal public object and a stub fixture helper; no historical scientific source is imported or evaluated.

finite_cases.case: Complete U cell through direct run_cell with literal candidate/reference stub returns, profile suppression/restoration, source/runtime records, durable captures and reconciled counts

Complete P cell through original-looking AuditPolicy and measure_wrapper stubs, requiring wrapper-to-AuditPolicy-to-candidate-to-reference order, original exclusive journal creation and durable nested journal directory entries
Candidate return-capture write fails and prevents reference; record one observed method return and an unconfirmed capture

First active-call publication is absent until a complete fsynced temporary file is linked; publication uses no-clobber, reserves both temporary/final path bytes against ordinary and terminal caps, and later replacement remains atomic
First active-call publication file-fsync or link failure preserves its temporary prefix and exposes no partial target; repeated exclusive publication preserves existing bytes
Nested directory creation fsyncs each new directory and its parent, both for write and append

Original integrity failure plus secondary cell-receipt resource failure re-raises the original typed failure and writes an independently bounded reserved failure sidecar despite a full ordinary evidence budget

Fixed OSError subclasses PermissionError, FileNotFoundError and BrokenPipeError classify as infrastructure after invocation; the three distinct frozen-module ResourceExceeded class counterparts, MemoryError and IntegrityError retain separate typed classifications
Initial wrong runtime and initial import preflight failures record execution_blocked with zero invocation bounds
Source drift after a completed preflight records integrity_invalid and does not enter either method
Failure writing candidate-start marker prevents method invocation and records zero lower/upper method-entry bounds
An original literal stub method exception proves one observed method entry but no return; invocation-attempt and pre-call marker fields remain distinct
A returned original method followed by clock failure remains an observed return in the live receipt without inventing a successful timing/capture
Reserved failure-sidecar fsync failure cannot replace an original integrity exception and preserves a bounded temporary prefix

data_policy: Use one explicitly literal invented public object, unchanged literal stub science fields and standard Random states only for the run_cell interface. Stub scientific fields are filled from those object/RNG hashes; no real fixture, real dataset, policy body, generated/fuzzed scenario or historical constructor execution is permitted. Runtime/source pins are bypassed only through test-local unittest.mock replacements, never via production test modes or weakened pins.
test_execution: This worker writes the prospective plan and tests without running tests, executing run_cell or importing historical sources. The parent may run only the fixed tests after review and separate authorization.
